notes.title: Added NewGame+ song
notes.content: At the end of a NewGame+, during a perfect ending, while the credits are rolling, a new and original song will play.

notes.title: Circus and Dinosaur update!
notes.content:
CIRCUS AND DINOSAUR UPDATE!

Find the traveling circus multiple times, where you can play mini-games, buy new items, and help find out why everyone there is so sad.

In the desert, find a dig site, where you can dig up treasures and fossils.
Get new weapons, and face new enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889123/0c244a72c6e7120e4b2403a172f1be66a0feab95.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy this new update!

notes.title: Animation Patch Update
notes.content:
Regrettably, this patch will make all previous saves glitch out. It was unavoidable.
I apologize if this has caused stress to any players.

notes.title: Animal graphics update
notes.content:
Small update for the graphics of the animals, mostly for their walking sprite animation.
Nothing too much, just defining them a little bet more so they all match closer in quality, and to make them a little less cartoony.
The bird is given the biggest update. It is the only one with a major update to it's battle sprite. It looks much more realistic.
I hope everyone enjoys this update, even if it is a small one.

notes.title: Styles and Icons
notes.content:
Use Icons to change your style to change your look

You can buy icons from a new store clerk that is usually in the weapons shop.

You may also find or earn special icons throughout the world and make yourself look even better.

Don't get too settled with these icons though, because more may be coming.
